programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Madrangi
programme.desc: Deepu, the daughter of a rich businessman, falls in love with her driver Manu. Problems arise when Manu suffers a brain injury and is blamed for the death of an MLA's brother.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police
programme.desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Main Hun Ziddi
programme.desc: Bollywood action starring Prajwal Devaraj, 2013.

programme.title: Market Raja MBBS
programme.desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Jadugar Ki Kahar
programme.desc: Bollywood drama starring Devaraj, 2009.

programme.title: Mithya
programme.desc: Albert Samson, a successful architect, and Alice are leading an unhappy married life because of Samson's ambitious and egoistic nature. Hilda Varghese enters Samson's life and changes it completely.

programme.title: Illaka
programme.desc: Raja and Suman, two sons of a labour leader, choose different professions in their life after facing numerous difficulties from childhood to adulthood.

The baby song 'We use a sponge to wash!' features, as does a story involving Baby Bear.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: S6 E5 — Iona and Elba's Mission to MarsIona and Elba make bird feeders as a present for their Nanny Pip and Gramps, who they are visiting. They place the feeders around the garden and wait patiently for birds to arrive, hoping they'll discover the tasty treats.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: S1 — Busy the BeeJen is a rock star in the café today, but Small is too small to play any of the instruments. Meanwhile, Busy the Bee visits the café for a speedy snack and leaves them the perfect gift.

programme.title: Go Wild

programme.title: What's on Your Head?

While photographing them, Andy discovers unusual markings on some of the trees. With Jen's help, he sets out to discover what's making them and reveals an unlikely dinosaur culprit. Along the way, he meets a herd of Pachycephalosaurus and watches two males headbutting each other in a show of dominance.

She then visits a paper mill to see how the old paper is recycled into newspapers.

Leon takes charge of keeping the classroom tidy and ends up being awarded a certificate for all his hard work.

He ignited a religious and parliamentary revolution, which laid the foundations for the modern British state.

programme.title: Anita Brookner on Art: 100 Great Paintings
programme.desc: Anita Brookner, art historian, TV presenter and author of the Booker Prize-winning Hotel du Lac, added to her accomplishments in the 1980s by sharing with television audiences her understanding and appreciation for some of the finest works by the world's greatest ever painters. In this collection, Anita's contributions to the BBC's 1981 series 100 Great Paintings are brought together in one place to create a masterclass in art appreciation, with her unique insights helping to increase our awareness of the cultural significance and creative processes behind works by the likes of Cezanne, Ingres, Delacroix and David.

programme.title: Love Your Garden

The car belongs to former engineer Billy, whose life was turned upside down several years ago when his son and daughter-in-law were drowned on their honeymoon in South Africa. The team manage to bring the car back from the brink after the show's biggest salvage operation to date, and the boys enlist actor James Nesbitt to present Billy with his newly restored vehicle

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: A tense emergency unfolds as illicit drugs are found onboard a plane, and the airport hosts a fashion show

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: How an insect nest was blamed for an accident in which a Boeing 737 failed to respond when contacted, subsequently crashing into the sea off Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, in 1996

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: After a nighttime crossing of the Savio River, a platoon of Canadian tank hunters fights off Nazi Panther tanks with only the weapons they can carry

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Careening into a mountaintop just minutes from the runway, an American charter flight becomes the worst aviation disaster in Portuguese history

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand

programme.title: Drain the Oceans

programme.title: Contraband Capture

programme.title: Lords of War

programme.desc: The nuclear meltdown at Three Mile Island, and a small truck fire that became a lethal inferno

programme.desc: Documentary investigating the infamous disappearances of ships and aircraft, adopting the rather unorthodox technique of exploring the area's ominous reputation by 'draining the water from it' to see what exactly lies below the surface of the mythical triangle. programme.title: The Mosquito Coast
programme.desc: 1986. Director: Peter Weir. Stars Harrison Ford, Helen Mirren And River Phoenix. An inventor spurns his city life and moves his family into the jungles of Central America to make a utopia. [S]

programme.title: The Flaw
programme.desc: 1955. Crime directed by Terence Fisher. A racing driver (John Bentley) plans to murder his heiress wife (Rona Anderson). The lawyer (Donald Houston) discovers the plot. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Scientist. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Alan Wheatley And Archie Duncan. A scientist who is being hunted down, after developing a terrifying new weapon, seeks Robin's help. [S]

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Heads or Tails. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Richard Bebb And Raf De La Torre. Released from prison after serving eight years, Bill Weldon sets out to kill the three men who testified against him. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Phantom Piper. 1961. Stars Graydon Gould, David Graham And George Murcell. The Supercar team heads to Scotland to investigate reports of a ghostly bagpiper. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Fame and the Fury. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Patrick Holt And Sandra Dome. Celia's partner is a struggling painter. But when she leaves him for a wealthier man, she soon realises her mistake. [S]

programme.title: The Triumph of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: 1935. Mystery. Directed by Leslie S. Hiscott. Stars Arthur Wontner, Lyn Harding And Jane Carr. Sherlock Holmes puts his retirement on hold to investigate one last case with his sidekick Dr. Watson. [S]

programme.title: Life in The Past Lane with Noel
programme.desc: Noel visits and opens the Ribbon of Dreams exhibition at the Elstree And Borehamwood Museum celebrating 100 years of Elstree Studios.

programme.title: Battle of the V1
programme.desc: 1958. War. Director: Vernon Sewell. Stars Michael Rennie, Patricia Medina And Christopher Lee. Polish Resistance discover a mysterious pilot-less plane. [S]

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Squatters. 1975. Stars Peter Craze, Rio Fanning And John Kane. The council want to evict a commune, but how far is too far when the squatters resist? [S]

programme.title: Saloon Bar
programme.desc: 1940. Thriller. Director: Walter Forde. Stars: Gordon Harker, Elizabeth Allan And Mervyn Johns. A group of pub locals set out to prove that a local is not guilty of murder to prevent a hanging. [S]

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Devil is Unloosed. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Iain Gregory And Sheila Whittingham. Prince John is told by a fortune teller that Richard is dead, so he makes plans to proclaim himself King. [S]

programme.title: Glimpses: London River Bus late 1940s
programme.desc: ... 1940s. Take a trip on The Thames from Greenwich, where many of London's historic features are to be seen: Tower Bridge, The Tower Of London, St Pauls, the 'new' Waterloo Bridge And on to Westminster

programme.title: The Man In The Sky
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director: Charles Crichton. Stars Jack Hawkins, Elizabeth Sellars And Walter Fitzgerald. John Mitchell is on a flight fraught with disaster but Mitchell is determined to land the plane. [S]

programme.title: The Third Man
programme.desc: 1949. Director: Carol Reed. Stars Orson Welles, Joseph Cotten And Alida Valli. A pulp novelist travels to Vienna only to find himself investigating the sudden death of old friend Harry Lime. [S]

programme.title: Talking Pictures with Hayley Mills
programme.desc: Mike Read sits down with Hayley Mills to discuss her iconic roles in this exclusive Talking Pictures interview. [S]

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1962. A Woman's Privilege. Starring Bernard Archard, Ann Lynn and Patrick Wymark. Based on a real criminal case, a shipboard romance leads to a lawsuit for breach of promise. [S] (S1, E02)

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Visit the location of the James Bond film 'A View To Kill' with some behind the scenes footage. After a nostalgic train trip, meet the unique Sinclair C5 and learn about the first vacuum cleaner! [S]

programme.title: Maigret
